title: Oven-Roasted Indulgent Middle-Eastern Chicken Tagine
description: A rich and creamy Middle-Eastern dish featuring the deep flavors of prunes, allspice, and cumin, roasted to perfection in the oven.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the allspice, cumin, cinnamon, ginger, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken thighs to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Sear the chicken thighs until browned on both sides, about 5 minutes.
Transfer the chicken to a plate and set aside.
In the same pot, add the prunes and cook, stirring occasionally, until they start to soften, about 5 minutes.
Add the chicken back to the pot and pour in 1 cup of chicken broth.
Cover the pot with a lid and transfer it to the preheated oven. Roast for 30 minutes.
Remove the pot from the oven and season the chicken and sauce with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the chicken and sauce over couscous or rice, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
